package ui

// The stand-in for video_review_hooks_test.go on the round-3 head
// (0cbe7e63), which has neither: its players' FrameReady is a.animReady
// (video.go), which calls the huddle controller's ImagesChanged whenever
// one is live (quiet.go). This counts those calls as it makes them.

var redHudPings int64

func playerFrameReady(e *perfEnv) func() {
	return func() {
		if e.a.hudLive.Load() != nil {
			redHudPings++
		}
		e.a.animReady()
	}
}

func hudPings(e *perfEnv) int64 { return redHudPings }
